alarm_routes_not_saved.title: Noonlight: cancelling after a restart is unavailable
alarm_routes_not_saved.description: Home Assistant could not save (or load) the information needed to cancel Noonlight alarms after a restart. Alarms are still created, and noonlight.cancel_alarm works until Home Assistant restarts. Alarms created while this lasts cannot be cancelled from Home Assistant after a restart: answer Noonlight's call or text and give your PIN. Check the log for storage errors; this clears itself once saving works again.
